pr.body:
The discovery handoff emphasized a narrow cost benchmark enough to obscure the broader research goal. The protocol and continuation prompt now explicitly recognize a useful, moderately novel contribution with a supported delta and credible verification path as a worthwhile outcome.

The clarification preserves the 75% generation/development, 20% cheap screening, and 5% synthesis/readiness allocation; treats current technical leads as options within the broader portfolio; and separates F01's candidate-specific forecast from overall program progress. An ordinary equivalent's tie limits superiority claims without automatically disqualifying a useful synthesis. A dated author-decision record preserves the clarification and attribution. The recovery pointer also records PR #11's merger.

Historical findings, forecasts, clocks, and advancement status are unchanged. This documentation update earns zero research credit.
